title.zh: Pirate Chain确认近日遭攻击，代币供应量增发约20%
title.en: Pirate Chain确认近日遭攻击，代币供应量增发约20%

current_state.zh: Pirate Chain confirmed a transaction-validation vulnerability that created roughly 39.8 million unauthorized ARRR (about 20% of supply), prompting dPoW operators to pause notarization and the team to ask exchanges and mining pools to suspend operations while a recovery plan is drawn up.
current_state.en: Pirate Chain confirmed a transaction-validation vulnerability that created roughly 39.8 million unauthorized ARRR (about 20% of supply), prompting dPoW operators to pause notarization and the team to ask exchanges and mining pools to suspend operations while a recovery plan is drawn up.
